Ugly Within | 醜イ is a Japanese survival horror game where the past hides terrifying secrets, and the line between faith and madness begins to blur.

UGLY is never far away.
UGLY can happen to anyone.
UGLY lives within you.

Step into the lives of Shu Onodera, a young man with the ability to see the past, and Reiko Miyama, an exorcist who confronts supernatural entities.

Together, they unravel the dark history of the Kamata family and the mysterious entity it has worshipped for generations.

As Shu, explore haunting environments, uncover hidden truths, and solve intricate puzzles while evading supernatural horrors.

As Reiko, confront terrifying entities and fight to banish them through exorcism.

What was born from faith, love, and hatred?

Will you call what you see “Ugly”?

Meet Yurie Hoyoyon, the voice of Aki Mizuno in Signal Veil!

Signal Veil is a classic-style psychological survival horror game featuring an art style inspired by 1990s anime.

After inheriting her mother's old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena that no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, she must confront grotesque spirits, mysterious messages, and a reality that begins to unravel.

Explore unsettling environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki's phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what the naked eye cannot see, and fight to survive with limited resources and tactical combat.

Listen to the signal. Face what lies beyond the veil.
